name: Candidacy result
description: How a candidacy ended. Withdrawn and disqualified are kept apart from just losing. A candidate who never faced voters isn't the same as one who lost. Mixing them up throws off every result calculated afterward.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Disqualified
hasDefinedTerm.description: Removed from the ballot by the body running the election.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Tied
hasDefinedTerm.description: Tied for the highest vote count. What happens next depends on local tie-breaking rules.
